research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Varonis Systems is researching automated permissions management, as described in 'Method and system for automated permissions management' and 'Automatic management of user permissions,' which detail grouping users and generating cluster-based permissions. about_short_description.short_description: Varonis secures AI and the data that powers it.

product.name: Varonis Data Security Platform
product.description: A SaaS-based platform for discovering and classifying sensitive data, analyzing access, remediating exposure, monitoring activity, and detecting data-centric threats across cloud, SaaS, hybrid, and on-premises environments.

product.name: Varonis Atlas
product.description: An AI security platform that monitors and protects AI applications, agents, models, data, and interactions across the AI data lifecycle, including enterprise AI platforms and development environments.

product.name: Varonis Interceptor
product.description: An AI-native email and browser security solution that detects phishing and social engineering attacks, blocks malicious websites and credential theft, and applies controls to prevent email-based data leaks.

product.name: Varonis Next-Gen DAM
product.description: An agentless database activity monitoring product that monitors activity across cloud, on-premises, managed, and unmanaged databases to help detect threats and protect sensitive database data.

product.name: Managed Data Detection & Response (MDDR)
product.description: A managed security service that provides continuous monitoring, threat hunting, alert investigation, and incident response for customer data environments around the clock.

product.name: Varonis Concierge
product.description: A professional services offering that provides expert guidance and hands-on assistance with deploying, configuring, operating, and improving Varonis data security capabilities.
